Uses of Package
org.tmt.aps.peas.session.model

  • Packages that use org.tmt.aps.peas.session.model 
    Package Description
    org.tmt.aps.peas.common
    Utility classes for managing coordinate data, lists of coordinates, encoding coordinates lists to and from string formats that are used to store coordinate lists in a database; the package also contains utilities for generating messages using resource bundles and utilities for generating error and success messages for all cases in PEAS (record update, procedure execution, command execution and generic).
    org.tmt.aps.peas.common.ui
    Common user interface components supporting field display using metadata stored in the database.
    org.tmt.aps.peas.config.business
    Database updates/queries for constants, global configuration, procedure configuration; configuration data caches; real-time configuration of external interfaces.
    org.tmt.aps.peas.frame.model
    Data classes related to CCD frames; database entities, FITS file data, marking data.
    org.tmt.aps.peas.procedure.business
    Procedure execution management, procedure execution state, procedure store and retrieval, procedure output store and retrieval.
    org.tmt.aps.peas.procedure.executor
    Executors for procedures and subflows implemented as Singleton EJBs.
    org.tmt.aps.peas.procedure.model
    Procedure database related entities and the complete procedure output class hierarchy
    org.tmt.aps.peas.session.business
    Database queries and updates for night session records; field metadata caches.
    org.tmt.aps.peas.session.model
    Database entities and interfaces related to night sessions, field metadata and external interface configuration
    org.tmt.aps.peas.session.ui
    Session related user interface controller, managing external interface connections and access permissions
